items.why: Pivotal raised its target to $930 and kept a Buy rating, citing early Muse adoption and the new Muse Wonder models.
Apple rallied near buy points while chip names fell, and BofA noted shorter iPhone 18 Pro wait times ahead of pre-order shipments.
Microsoft is rolling out new AI chips meant to cut dependence on Nvidia chips, which lifted shares and pushed its market cap above $4 trillion.
Chip stocks stayed weak as investors want AI announcements to turn into purchase orders, and reports flagged competition from China's CXMT.

market_note: Futures were muted early as investors awaited big bank earnings, with chip weakness weighing on Nasdaq futures.
summary: Stocks were mixed midmorning, with the S&P about flat while the Nasdaq slipped as chip stocks stayed weak. Big tech split, with Meta, Apple, and Microsoft higher while chip names lagged.
